searchText: Update EIP-7873: unban TXCREATE in legac... to write it here too, alternatively we could make a `FRACTION` part of `EXT*CALL`'s input and with it remove a need for `PAY` opcode. Can someone explain to me why we are introducing new Initcode tx type, and can't continue using data from Legacy creation tx? https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/EIPS/eip-7698.md CREATE factories. We need a way to bring multiple contracts to bear in a single TX and address them by content. Such as in an AA aggregated transaction. Three user operations, each deploying a contract. We can put all three in a single aggregated TX for the entry point and load their contracts into the initcode. TXCREATE addresses by hash, so we can order the contracts as needed (vs 3 UOs all referencing slot 1) Aha in previous way you could only deploy one contract per tx as it is a create. Thanks
